glosses: To make a hole through something.

glosses: To make a hole with, or as if with, a boring instrument; to cut a circular hole by the rotary motion of a tool.

examples.text: to bore for water or oil

glosses: To form or enlarge (something) by means of a boring instrument or apparatus.

examples.text: This timber does not bore well.
